angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop lean (Hoop G) as a day-3 film flag. One test, written down for 2026: Hoop G against a held-out pick + role forecast of career pressure rate, leave-one-class-out over 2023-25
metric_name: Hoop G: how hard a lineman leans through the tightest part of the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight (speed^2 / turn radius at his hardest half-second, in g, z within Combine year)
headline_number: +2.3 pressures per 450 rushes per sd of Hoop G [95%: 0.7, 4.0], n=77, held-out classes, beyond pick + role. Within-class-and-role shuffles: slope p = 0.001; held-out R2 gain 0.06 (0.10 -> 0.16), p = 0.005. Fit on 2023-24 (+3.1 [1.2, 4.8]), tested on 2025: +0.6 [-1.5, 2.6] (difference p = 0.10). Share through NFL bend: 8% as measured, 19% [-11, 78] with lap and rush noise removed.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 24 cand_1 (8.38). Lede rewritten around the writeup judge's plain claim, with a one-sentence coach definition and 'mechanism unknown' stated up front. About 8 flags in 2026 and the 59% hit rate each appear once. DS: the headline is restated as the one 2026 test with a 95% interval. Added a held-out R2 gain with a permutation p from the same within-class-and-role shuffles, and a 2023+24 -> 2025 prospective test with 95% intervals and 2025 R2. Negative controls run through the same pipeline: five straight-line DL measures stay flat (|slope| <= 1.3, min p 0.08), OL long-pull lean against OL pressures allowed reads -1.1 [-2.9, 0.6], n=61. Disclosed: wave-drill lean is also positive (+1.8 [0.1, 3.6]). Measurement-error model: regression calibration with shrunk random-effects estimates (Hoop G reliability 0.44, NFL bend 0.43); the through-bend share moves from 8% to 19% [-11, 78]. Football: role prescriptions dropped. Four names are chosen by fixed rules (Solomon and C. Johnson hits, Harrell and Watts misses), each with a compact table row, one tape confirm/kill line and clip locations (grafted from the cand_2 runner-up). The play-log is folded into two sentences. Writeup: Table 2 is cut to pick + role and shrunk-full rows with columns R2, R2 with Hoop G and slope [95%]. Pick-only, team resampling, the checks list, the drill-to-Sunday links table, corner turns and the placebo histogram moved to the appendix; jargon removed (no sha256 in the text). Viz: Fig 1 rebuilt as small multiples, hoop laps and NFL rushes coloured on one lean scale with each path's peak marked and pressured snaps shown; Fig 2 is new (tests + controls at 95%; mediation as a unit-free share, intervals unobscured, no legend to clip); Fig 3 adds per-row NFL-rush sparklines, career rushes and pressured-of-sampled counts, with one colour rule (call) shared with Fig 1, so Harrell is vermillion in both; the placebo moved to Fig A2 (slope and R2-gain nulls from the same shuffles).
open_risks: Wave-drill lean also predicts pressure (+1.8 [0.1, 3.6], p 0.04) while barely tracking Hoop G (rho 0.11): the signal may be general lateral body control, not the hoop arc
The 2025 class did not confirm: +0.6 [-1.5, 2.6] and a lower 2025 R2 with Hoop G (-0.62 -> -0.80); the gap to the 2023-24 slope is only p = 0.10

Forking paths remain: Hoop G was the best of six measures (best-of-six p 0.05) and the classes were explored before the comparator was fixed; 2026 is the only clean test, and one class has only about 59% power
The noise-corrected mediation share (19% [-11, 78]) depends on the reliability source (13% with split-half NFL bend reliability); the mechanism is unresolved, not refuted
No film: tape lines and clip locations are pointers, not confirmations; the NFL side rests on a median 17 sampled rushes per man
Day-3 top third is 9/15 for both Hoop G and pick order: no evidence Hoop G picks better tape
